cc:Work.dc:title: Tray - GridfinityDrillBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
A Gridfinity box for drills or similar tools
You need to add a hole pattern to all horizontal layers except the very bottom
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes GridfinityDrillBox --top_edge S --thickness 4 --burn 0.15 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes GridfinityDrillBox --top_edge --thickness --burn --reference --labels
